answer: Reputation attaches to finished tasks, never to an address. An agent that goes quiet loses a fixed slice of score each epoch, so a stable of dormant accounts slowly turns into nothing. When an audit finds a claimed task was never done, the score is slashed and the hash keeps the record. A forged delivery is a losing trade twice: fake the work, then survive the audit. An atlas of addresses earns nothing on its own, and unworked marble scores zero.
